decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program is part of Teckentrup's publicly announced delivery-speed positioning, its logistics investment is already sunk, and any weak uptake can be blamed on the temporary construction slowdown.
The seventy-two-hour program is a visible service promise tied to the firm's express strategy, so management is likely to persist and attribute modest demand to the cyclical construction downturn.
The fire-resistant exterior door has European approval, was launched prominently at BAU and featured on the home page, and extends the core Teckentrup 62 modular system, so commitment is very high.
Having a dedicated page shows strong public commitment to express delivery of doors and gates as a strategic differentiator, which makes withdrawal unlikely.
The online ordering platform carries substantial sunk IT investment and fits the announced digitalization direction, and slow adoption can be seen as a temporary ramp-up phase.
Fire and smoke protection doors are a core, certification-intensive product line, so the investment and strategic centrality make dropping them very unlikely.
